Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the KV caching behavior. We're ramping a short canary to validate p95 at our real traffic profile and would like to request a promotional top-up and a short extension to the trial window so we can run a 48-hour focused latency canary against production-like traffic.

Scope: 48 hours, targeted traffic shape (see attached POC_Canary_Run_Plan.xlsx), goal: p95 <= 220ms across our most common 1, 2, and 4k token flows.
Ask: +150k token promo credit, trial extension of 7 calendar days from the current expiration, and a DocuSign addendum outlining the limited use and data treatment. We can start as early as Jun 14 if that's acceptable.

We're happy to provide a short post-run readout and a short quote on performance if this helps marketing. Also attaching our traffic matrix and timeline.

Thanks — Carlos
Carlos Mendes
Head of Platform
ApiWorks

Carlos — really glad the demo resonated. Quick read of the plan looks clean. I'm proposing we provision a conditional 150k token promo top-up for the 48h canary with the following guardrails:

- Activation window: a single 48h contiguous window, start date to be confirmed (you suggested Jun 14).
- Rate cap: soft daily cap of 90k tokens/day (to prevent runaway consumption).
- Acceptance: we need a signed addendum (DocuSign) that limits use to the canary and preserves telemetry access for Redwood for troubleshooting.
- Reporting: ApiWorks agrees to provide a 1-page post-run summary and a quick sync within 3 business days.

If that works I'll kick the approval through our internal approvals and send a DocuSign link. CC'ing Marissa and Markus to speed internal sign-off.
